note: Building catalogue (Rulebook Appendix pp39-44 + Buildings board + mod tile text). size: S = 1 map space, 1 use/round; L = both spaces of a tile, 2 uses/round. ins = insulation colour of the base / upgraded side: W white (no action, insulation irrelevant), B blue (only heated if in a heated zone), Y yellow, O orange, R red. build = {wood, core}. upgrade = cost to flip to the upgraded side (null = cannot be upgraded). engineer = only Engineer meeples may use the action (Worker-gated otherwise: any Worker/Engineer/Child per action rules; Automatons may use any non-engineer action). action/upgAction: {cost:[pay tokens], fx:[FX tokens]}; upgAction 'same' = identical. Costs use pay:<res>:<n> (wood|coal|core|steel|food), tokens inside a choose option make that option conditional on being payable. limit = number of tiles in the box (supply limit); shared tile = paired flip-side tile (Cemetery/Propaganda Centre etc.). Shelters flip to Ruins when a Storm hits (Tent first Storm, Bunkhouse second Storm in Crater); Ruins cannot be built. Large building rules: needs a map tile with both spaces free (no meeple, no other building).
tokens: gatherAdjacent:1       take 1 Resource from each adjacent space
devBack:<n>            Workshop sub-effect (Development token back on Round track)

buildings.name: Generator
buildings.note: First time a Steam Core is spent here place the Generator Upgrade piece (raises cube retention). Tech T06 adds one extra Stress cube removal when this building is used.

buildings.name: Workshop
buildings.note: First Workshop built starts Technology development. Cannot upgrade a building that has a meeple on it. Same on both sides. Law L18 lets Workers use Workshops.

buildings.name: Charcoal Kiln
buildings.note: Tech T03: may remove a Tree from any map tile instead of paying 1 Wood.

buildings.name: Hunter's Hut
buildings.note: Hunting symbols pay 1 Food each in every Weather phase.

buildings.name: Gathering Post
buildings.note: Upgrade only improves insulation. Law L01 allows Child meeples here.

buildings.name: Sawmill
buildings.note: Action requires a Tree to remove; Tech T10 gives +1 Wood.

buildings.name: Medical Post
buildings.note: Tech T05: may Treat 2 instead of the normal effect. Law L12 lets it convert Food into Cure.

buildings.name: Coal Thumper
buildings.note: Place up to 3 Coal from the bank on each of N different adjacent spaces (spaces must already hold Coal or be empty of Resources/Trees/Buildings; 5 Coal max per space). Tech T13: also gain 2 Coal.

buildings.name: Hothouse
buildings.note: Tech T15: with an Engineer meeple may move the Corpse marker back 1 for +3 Food.

buildings.name: Wall Drill
buildings.note: Upgrade only improves insulation. Tech T10: +1 Wood.

buildings.name: Ruins
buildings.note: Flip side of House/Bunkhouse/Tent. No effect, no shelter (unless Law L06). Occupies its space.

buildings.name: Cemetery
buildings.text: Move the Corpse marker back 1 to 2 spaces. If you do, increase Hope.

buildings.name: Faith Keepers
buildings.text: Draw 3 Dusk cards, may choose 1 (not Social Dispute) to discard without effect, shuffle the other 2 back.

buildings.name: Propaganda Centre
buildings.text: Choose any Building with a Citizen Meeple on it and perform its action (counts as heated).

buildings.name: Prison
buildings.text: Reduce Hunger by 4. The meeple stays in Prison during the Night phase (uses it as Shelter if heated, otherwise becomes sick).

buildings.name: Steam Hub
buildings.text: At any time, if the Heat marker is above the red indicator level, place 1 Coal from the supply here: this tile and all adjacent tiles count as heated until the end of the Generator phase (Coal returns to the bank).

dreadnought.text: Treat each Dreadnought tile as a Small Building with Blue insulation (heated only in a heated zone). Placing a Meeple there is a Use a Building action gaining 1 Steel. Steel (8 pieces) substitutes for Wood in Build sub-actions, mixing allowed; paying the full Wood cost in Steel upgrades the building immediately for free.
